name: openspec-board
description: Live pane for the OpenSpec lifecycle of a change: stages, task groups, agents, and tokens.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow runs beside the opsx-board mod: it reads the progress calls of opsx-board, opens only on /openspec-board, and shows no toast or status line. primary runs alone.

reportTool.title: Progress report tool
reportTool.description: In primary mode, ask /opsx:apply agents to report the task they work on, for task-level progress.
